grass.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG game/web asset for Henry the Train, placed at the foot of a metal railroad signal.
Primary request: A single small wide tuft or compact cluster of lush bright green meadow grass, isolated on an actually transparent alpha background.
Style/medium: painterly playful 3D storybook countryside illustration, softly modeled sunlit blades with delicate painterly texture, matching a cheerful summery meadow with saturated lime yellow-green highlights and deeper rich green bases. Gentle varied curved grass blades, friendly and natural.
Composition/framing: approximately 3:1 width-to-height composition; one low, wide coherent grass cluster centered on a wide canvas with generous transparent margins on every side. Show the entire tuft with a clean irregular blade silhouette and a soft grassy base. The tuft should work as small foreground dressing at ground level.
Constraints: background must be truly transparent in the PNG alpha channel, not white, black, checkerboard or any painted background. Preserve anti-aliased transparent edges.
Avoid: no rock, no earth or soil slab, no flowers, no metal post, no signal, no pot, no extra objects, no landscape, no frame, no text, no logo, no watermark.

integrated.notes: Actual rock placement from selected image is reflected in the camera and touch target. Export retains native grass alpha.
